title: Investor | Luxury Second Homes by DarGlobal
text: ## Investor Relations ##### DarGlobal Today DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer specializing in exclusive luxury developments across the world’s most coveted cosmopolitan cities. Catering to global citizens seeking prime investments, second homes, and luxury living, DarGlobal transforms real estate into economic catalysts, unlocking opportunities for both investors and the countries it enters. DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. These collaborations offer unique investment opportunities in global cities, providing both wealth growth and protection. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal goes beyond property development; it drives economic transformation by attracting international clients and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI). With a presence in 13 international cities across 8 countries, DarGlobal’s portfolio spans the United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, the United States, and Qatar. The company is also expanding into world-class hospitality, developing luxury hotels in Dubai, Muscat, Riyadh and Jeddah. To support its international clientele, DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha. [FACTSHEET](https://tools.euroland.com/factsheet/SA-DAAG/factsheethtml.asp?lang=english "FACTSHEET") ![Image 1: investor-relations-transform-1.webp](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/investor_relations_transform_1_1e73423c0a.webp) ![Image 2: LEADERS IN REAL ESTATE](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/leaders_87335c12db.webp) ##### LEADERS IN REAL ESTATE Listed on the London Stock Exchange since 2023, we’re building on three decades of development know-how. Every opportunity is strategically curated and backed by market insight. Our partners represent forward-thinking luxury brands who share our passion for design: Aston Martin, W Hotels, Missoni, Automobili Lamborghini, to name a few. ![Image 3: A GLOBAL PRESENCE](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/global_presence_6c835da30a.webp) ##### A GLOBAL PRESENCE From London to Dubai, our portfolio spans 14 cities and 9 countries, offering prime access to the world’s most dynamic markets. We serve our international clientele from hubs in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha. ## leadership ![Image 4: Ziad el chaar](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Ziad_El_Chaar_1930b80550_435de476e5_cbe78b132d_1_1_48fd2a1652.png) As DarGlobal’s CEO, Ziad El Chaar leads the company’s strategic expansion and partnerships. Under his stewardship, DarGlobal was listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2023 and has forged exclusive collaborations with likeminded luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. El Chaar has pioneered DarGlobal’s diversification into the hospitality sector, while also overseeing innovative development projects across key markets in the UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and UK. ### Ziad el chaar Founder & chief executive officer ## DarGlobal at a Glance Total GDV ### USD 23 BN Presence in Cities ### 14 Presence in Countries ### 9 Global Sales Offices ### 9 [](tel:+1 212 715 1067 "Call to +1 212 715 1067").[](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=97180040409&text= "Chat with us on WhatsApp")

title: FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Darglobal
text: DarGlobal creates luxury properties and branded residences that blend lifestyle, design, and long-term value. Through global partnerships and meticulous craftsmanship, we deliver premium homes and communities built with integrity and purpose — offering investors a sense of belonging, measurable value, and a legacy that lasts. ## Why invest with DarGlobal? ![Image 1: Why invest with DarGlobal?](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/whyinvest_de3612e7ac.webp) DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL. ### Who is DarGlobal? DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging — value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward. ### What's ROI, ROE and ROL? * **ROI (Return on Investment)**: measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation. * **ROE (Return on Ego)**: the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for. * **ROL (Return on Legacy)**: the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow. We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure. Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride. With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future. ### What makes DarGlobal different? We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value. ### Where does DarGlobal operate? Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives. ### What types of properties do you offer? We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world’s most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow. ### Why partner with global brands? They deliver something rare — ROE (Return on Ego): the pride of owning what few can, and the distinction of belonging to a world defined by rarity, scarcity, and status. Each collaboration is designed to create an asset of identity and desire. ### Can international buyers invest? Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges, and secure, transparent investment frameworks. ### How does the buying process work? Select your property, consult our advisors, reserve securely, and complete your purchase digitally or through our global offices. ## Investing with DarGlobal ![Image 2: Investing with DarGlobal](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Investing_with_DG_e7bfbb2f43.webp) Experience smart global investing with DarGlobal — from Dubai to London, discover curated opportunities in world-class developments. ### How can I invest in DarGlobal properties? Investing with DarGlobal is designed to be seamless and global. Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are. ### What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties? Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today. ### Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors? Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected. ### What kind of returns can I expect? Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL. ### Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent? Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step. ## Our Luxury Properties & Projects ![Image 3: Our Luxury Properties & Projects](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Our_Luxury_Properties_and_Projects_d67af932fa.webp) Discover what makes our luxury properties and iconic collaborations truly exceptional worldwide. ### What types of properties does DarGlobal offer? From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments — every DarGlobal property is crafted for lifestyle, investment, and legacy. These are homes designed to live beautifully and invest confidently. ### Where are DarGlobal properties located? Across the world’s most desirable destinations: **Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London,** and more — each chosen for growth, desirability, and global appeal. ### What are co-branded residences? These are homes crafted in collaboration with the world’s most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity. ### Which upcoming projects are open for investment? Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including high-demand branded districts and resort-led communities. Your advisor can guide you to the opportunities best aligned with your investment goals. ### Do DarGlobal properties come fully furnished or customizable? Many of our branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options, allowing buyers to tailor their home to their lifestyle and aesthetic. ## Collaborations & Brand Partnerships ![Image 4: Collaborations & Brand Partnerships](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Collaborations_and_Brand_Partnerships_2b80b32183.webp) Where luxury craftsmanship meets global identity. ### Which global brands has DarGlobal collaborated with? DarGlobal partners with iconic names across fashion, hospitality, and design — delivering residences that carry global distinction and rarity. ### What makes co-branded residences unique? They offer something few can own: **ROE — Return on Ego.** Craftsmanship, scarcity, elevated lifestyle, and brand legacy come together to create homes that are not just lived in — they are admired. ### How do partnerships enhance property value? Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation. A branded residence is not just a property — it’s a global asset backed by decades of reputation. ### Which upcoming collaborations or branded projects are launching soon? DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally with full transparency. ## Buying Process & Ownership ![Image 5: Buying Process & Ownership](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Buying_Process_and_Ownership_2b7a1e71c0.webp) Discover a seamless buying experience tailored for HNWI and global investors. ### What is the process to buy a DarGlobal property? 1. Choose your property 2. Review the investment plan with our advisors 3. Reserve your unit securely 4. Sign digitally or through our offices worldwide 5. Complete payment and registration with full support from our team ### Can international buyers purchase DarGlobal properties? Yes — our global structure is designed for international ownership, offering straightforward procedures and access to attractive residency pathways where applicable. ### What payment plans are available? Each development offers flexible installment plans, making global investing accessible while maximizing capital efficiency. ### How does property registration work? Registration is completed with the respective land department or governing authority in each country. DarGlobal provides full guidance to ensure a smooth and compliant process. ### What documents or approvals are required to complete a property purchase? Typically: 1. Passport copy 2. Contact information 3. Reservation form 4. Payment details Certain markets may require additional documentation, and our advisors guide you step-by-step. ## About DarGlobal ![Image 6: About DarGlobal](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/About_Dar_Global_d538f215f1.webp) Crafting timeless luxury across continents — designed for living, legacy, and investment. ### Who is DarGlobal? DarGlobal creates real estate that speaks for itself — where design, integrity, and purpose come together. We collaborate with trusted global partners to build destinations that gain meaning and value over time. For the world citizen, we offer not just investment — but belonging. ### How long has DarGlobal been in luxury real estate? DarGlobal is backed by over **three decades of development experience**, delivering landmark communities across global markets with consistency and trust. ### What makes DarGlobal different? We deliver more than properties — we deliver results: 1. Wealth protected across cycles 2. Lifestyle defined by beauty and craftsmanship 3. Legacy that lives forward And we build with clarity, trust, and global partnerships that elevate every development. ### Where is DarGlobal headquartered and which markets do they operate in? DarGlobal is headquartered in London and operates across **14 cities in 9 countries**, including Spain, the UK, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, and the Maldives. ### Is DarGlobal a publicly listed company, and where is it traded? Yes, DarGlobal is publicly listed, offering investors the added confidence of regulated transparency and corporate governance.

PROPERTY TYPES IN AIDA [![Image 18: A5.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/A5_fafcd677e2.png)](https://darglobal.co.uk/aida-trump-villas "the power of living") ### the power of living ##### trump golf villas The Trump Golf Villas are directly situated at the frontlines of the Trump International Golf Club Oman in Aida, Muscat. [know more](https://darglobal.co.uk/aida-trump-villas "View More") [![Image 19: A8.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/A8_c108e1cf77.png)](https://darglobal.co.uk/aida-trump-international-cliff-villas "once in a lifetime") ### once in a lifetime ##### trump cliff villas Introducing The Trump Cliff Villas, an exclusive collection of 3-bedroom residences perched on the cliffside, offering unparalled sea views next to the Trump Hotel [know more](https://darglobal.co.uk/aida-trump-international-cliff-villas "View More") [![Image 20: azureoceanfrontvillas2-jpg.webp](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/azureoceanfrontvillas2_jpg_822d7f4e89.webp)](https://darglobal.co.uk/one-of-one/fendi-casa-azure-oceanfront-villas "Azure Oceanfront Villas") ### Azure Oceanfront Villas ##### Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of five-bedroom residences, suspended 130 meters above the sea, inside AIDA, Oman’s most prestigious gated coastal community. Interiors by FENDI Casa. Nothing in front of you. Nothing above you. Only the horizon. [Know More](https://darglobal.co.uk/one-of-one/fendi-casa-azure-oceanfront-villas "View More") [![Image 21: coastal 1.jpg](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/coastal_1_7918cde260.jpg)](https://darglobal.co.uk/aida-coastal-investment-villas "YOUR MEDITERRANEAN ESCAPE IN OMAN") ### YOUR MEDITERRANEAN ESCAPE IN OMAN ##### COASTAL INVESTMENT VILLAS Situated in AIDA, an exclusive gated community and renowned golfing destination, perched 130 meters above the pristine shores, these villas represent an unparalleled investment opportunity. Positioned so close to the sea that you can feel the refreshing ocean breeze, the Coastal Investment Villas offer an exceptional blend of modern design and timeless craftsmanship. [know more](https://darglobal.co.uk/aida-coastal-investment-villas "View More") [![Image 22: Why Invest In sunrise Haven Villas](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Dar_Global_AIDA_Attached_Villa_Front_a563238fcb.jpg)](https://darglobal.co.uk/Sunrise-Haven-Luxury-Villas "Your pre-qualified AirBnB Home") ### Your pre-qualified AirBnB Home ##### Sunrise Haven Luxury Villas At Sunrise Haven, every villa is fully furnished and ready for use as your private retreat or an exceptional vacation rental. [know more](https://darglobal.co.uk/amour-sans-detour-2 "View More") ## why invest in OMAN ### Oman is quickly becoming one of the most prominent commercial and cultural hubs in the region and is rapidly becoming a prime investment destination due to its attractive benefits. From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive. ![Image 26: why invest in OMAN](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Mask_group_10_7f72b17216.png) ### 01 Life-time Residency Visa for investors on projects in the ITC ### 02 Upcoming UAE-Muscat railway project ### 03 100% Freehold ownership for all nationalities ### 04 0% personal l income tax ### 05 0% Capital Gains tax ### 06 0% Inheritance tax(inheritance laws of owner’s country apply) ### 07 25 years exemption from corporate income taxes in special economic/free zones ### 08 Stable and Growing Economy economy with low inflation ### 09 One of the safest countries in the world ### 10 Ideal Location with easy access to the Gulf, Indian subcontinent, and Africa ### 11 Tourism Hub with projected earnings of $22.5bn by 2040 ### 12 Cosmopolitan community with over 100 nationalities ### 13 The Quality of Life Index by Numbeo ranked Oman 4th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in 2025. ### 14 Saudi-Oman Highway: Cuts travel by 16 hours, driving tourism and investment. ### 15 Exclusive mortgage program in Oman for resident and non-resident buyers, designed to enhance real estate returns. ## Location ## Frequently Asked Questions - AIDA Find answers about AIDA by DarGlobal in Muscat, Oman, including property ownership, branded residences, lifestyle amenities, and investment potential. AIDA is in Muscat, Oman, about 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, elevated 130 meters above sea level along the coastline, offering scenic views. Yes. If you are in Oman or planning a visit, you can visit the office and enjoy a private, one on one site tour, including a visit to the development, the views, and the latest construction updates. AIDA offers apartments, luxury villas, hotel residences, and branded or non-branded residences. Explore your options for investment or lifestyle living. Yes. The culmination of the first ever living experience, by the super automaker is the Penthouse. Spanning 14,768 sqft, where every square foot is worthy of a masterpiece. ![Image 12: Pagani Luxury penthouse](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/asdasdasdasdasdasadada_1da82ccb98.png) ## LIVING IN THE SPHERE The expansive residence extending the entire top floor is accented with the most unique feature of the penthouse, the sphere. A sphere completely constructed with geometric glass panes to give you 360 degree views, from the sweeping Dubai Canal to Downtown Dubai. ![Image 13: LIVING IN THE SPHERE](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Group_182_5855887767.jpg) ## ELEVATING THE STANDARDS OF LIVING Residents and guests arrive at the Pagani Penthouse in its very own personal elevator. After being welcomed inside, advanced domotics are available to respond to their every touch. ![Image 14: modern dining area](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/unlisted_the_villas2_d2fafcbb87.jpg) ## THE LIVING SPACES A timeless interpretation of automotive art. The living spaces are designed with heritage leather, and luxurious fabrics that are reminiscent to the interiors of a Pagani car. ![Image 15: Pagani-inspired design](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/unlisted_the_vilaas_pool2_077ae3cd10.png) ## THE PERSONAL SPACES Traces of the Italian supercar are steeped in hushed tones of the bedrooms, and en-suite bathrooms. The rooms are reminiscent of the ultra-modern interiors of the Pagani, serene and victorious. ![Image 16: luxury living room](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/the_pagani_penthouse_818b114f3d.png) ## LOCATION The Pagani Penthouse is perched on The DaVinci Tower, which sits at the heart of Dubai’s cultural district, surrounded by prominent landmarks, such as the Dubai Opera, exhibition centres, design houses, art galleries, and affluent neighbourhoods. This gives you the perfect opportunity to explore various shopping, dining, and cultural experiences by the Dubai Canal, Business Bay and Burj Khalifa. title: Painite Villas in Benahavis | Benahavis Property | DarGlobal
text: ## SIDE BY SIDE The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space. ![Image 1: Modern living room](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/DG_AL_Zafiro_Villa_Int_Living_e47a0e6ea6.jpg) ## PRIVATE SKY CAR LIFT The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea. ![Image 2: Lamborghini-inspired villa](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Painite_Villa_int_2_1_60c68388b9.jpg) ## THE VILLA The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury. ![Image 3: Panoramic views](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Painite_Villa_ext_copy_8eeb5194f9.jpg) ## THE VIEWS The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity. ![Image 4: Luxury hilltop villa](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/DG_AL_Tierra_Viva_Aerial_1_d6c70d43c2.jpg) ## THE AMENITIES Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty. ![Image 5: landscaped gardens](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/DG_AL_Tierra_Viva_Aerial_3_cd5a4f0704.jpg) ## LOCATION The Painite Villas are located in Tierra Viva in Marbella, one of the most affluent locations around the world. Home to the most stylish clubs, restaurants and hotels, as well as, shopping areas, exclusive marinas and breathtaking beaches. The villas are precisely nestled in the hills, only minutes away from the shores and in close proximity to 9 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banus. ![Image 6: Painite Villas](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/DG_AL_Tierra_Viva_Aerial_2_1_e3bf7f5278.jpg) ## FLOOR PLANS For floor plans, please join the waiting list.

text: ## First row to nature’s beauty. Nineteen pieces above the sea Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of five-bedroom residences, suspended 130 meters above the sea, inside AIDA, Oman’s most prestigious gated coastal community. Interiors by FENDI Casa. Nothing in front of you. Nothing above you. Privately gated. Limited in number. Built for distance. Designed for discretion. ![Image 2: DTS_my_own_summer_Daniel_Farò_Photos_ID9761.webp](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/DTS_my_own_summer_Daniel_Faro_Photos_ID_9761_c266d1eebe.webp) ## Interiors by FENDI Casa Interiors reflect the brand’s signature approach to craftsmanship and detail, combining refined materials with a contemporary design language. Custom furnishings, sculptural elements, and curated finishes create spaces that are both functional and expressive. ![Image 3: 25204-SE-DG-ZZ-CGI-ID-000008 1.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/25204_SE_DG_ZZ_CGI_ID_000008_1_028f57dc94.png) ## THE VILLAS SPECS Five-bedroom villas designed with a focus on proportion, functionality, and material quality. Key features include: • Branded interiors by FENDI Casa • Open-plan living and dining areas • Bespoke finishes and materials • Expansive glazing to maximise natural light • Carefully planned layouts for privacy and flow Each villa is composed to balance design clarity with everyday usability. ![Image 4: 25204-SE-DG-ZZ-CGI-ID-0000010 1.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/25204_SE_DG_ZZ_CGI_ID_0000010_1_d16f05720f.png) ## LIVING EXPERIENCE Each residence includes private outdoor spaces designed as extensions of the interior. • Expansive terraces • Landscaped gardens • Infinity-edge swimming pools These elements are positioned to create continuity between indoor and outdoor living. ![Image 5: c01_1 1.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/c01_1_1_208711eebb.png) ## THE VIEWS All villas are oriented toward the sea, ensuring uninterrupted views of the horizon. There are no structures above or in front, allowing full visual openness and a direct connection to the surrounding landscape. ![Image 6: 25204-SE-DG-ZZ-CGI-ID-0000011 1.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/25204_SE_DG_ZZ_CGI_ID_0000011_1_25ce108f14.png) ## LOCATION AIDA is a gated clifftop community overlooking the Gulf of Oman, spanning over 4.3 million sqm. The city integrates residential, golfing, and hospitality components, including: • Trump International Golf Club • Luxury hotels and resorts • Beaches and coastal access • Wellness and outdoor facilities Located approximately 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, AIDA offers both accessibility and seclusion. ![Image 7: c01 6.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/c01_6_901de84add.png) ## FLOOR PLAN For floor plans, please join the waiting list. ![Image 8: FENDI_Casa_Sohoft_Toan_Nguyen_seating_system_ambient_6-crop-16-04-2025-10-49-12.jpg](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/FENDI_Casa_Sohoft_Toan_Nguyen_seating_system_ambient_6_crop_16_04_2025_10_49_12_907c14ffdd.jpg)

The structural completion milestone was celebrated by the company’s Chairman, Yousef Al Shelash, as he visited site and participated in the topping out ceremony.](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-al-arkan-tops-out-its-urban-oasis-by-missoni-residential-tower-in-dubai-at-34-stories "DarGlobal tops out its Urban Oasis by Missoni residential tower in Dubai at 34 stories") ## Frequently Asked Questions - Missoni ### What Missoni-branded projects has DarGlobal developed? DarGlobal has partnered with Missoni on two projects: [Urban Oasis](https://darglobal.co.uk/urban-oasis-by-missoni) in Dubai and [Marea](https://darglobal.co.uk/Marea) in Cortesin, Spain. ### Where is Urban Oasis located? [Urban Oasis](https://darglobal.co.uk/urban-oasis-by-missoni) sits on the Dubai Water Canal in the heart of Dubai, close to Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall. ### Where is Marea located? Marea is located near the Finca Cortesin hotel and golf club on Spain's Costa del Sol, close to Marbella, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande. ### What types of residences does Urban Oasis offer? [Urban Oasis](https://darglobal.co.uk/urban-oasis-by-missoni) spans 38 floors with one, two and three-bedroom apartments plus four-bedroom penthouses accessible via private elevator. ### What types of residences does Marea offer? [Marea](https://darglobal.co.uk/Marea) offers two, three and four-bedroom apartments within an 18,500 square metre complex. ### What is the value of Urban Oasis? Urban Oasis is valued at AED 800 million. ### What amenities does Urban Oasis offer? Residents have access to a swimming pool, a children's play area, car parking, a gymnasium and 24/7 concierge and security services. ### What amenities does Marea offer? [Marea](https://darglobal.co.uk/marea) offers premium security, a state-of-the-art gym, an infinity pool, a tennis court and children's play areas. ### Who designed the interiors? Urban Oasis was furnished by Missoni's MissoniHome line; Marea's interiors were curated by Alberto Caliri, Missoni home collection creative director, under Rosita Missoni's supervision. ### Is this Missoni's first real estate collaboration? Urban Oasis marked the Arab world's first bespoke Missoni-inspired living spaces; Marea followed as Missoni's second residential partnership with DarGlobal. Da Vinci Tower is located in Downtown Dubai, directly on the Dubai Canal, with views of the Burj Khalifa and moments from Marasi Business Bay. The tower offers 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences ranging from 77 to 398 sq m, each with private outdoor areas and panoramic views of the canal and Downtown Dubai. Yes. Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residential development with interiors by Pagani, applying the brand's design philosophy to luxury living. Interiors crafted by Pagani feature premium leather, Italian marble, kinetic chandeliers, carbon fibre accents and lush wood panelling. This landmark collaboration marks W's vision for redefining modern luxury carried into a permanent address. Two spirits. Both restless, both urban. The result? Contemporary amenities designed for how you actually live, steps from the city's icons. It's more than a residence, it's a stage for the city. It's luxury, wide awake. ## related projects [![Image 8: W Residence](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/WRD_Summit_1_86b103f80d.jpg) Dubai| United Arab Emirates ### W Residences](https://darglobal.co.uk/w-residences "W Residences") [![Image 9: W Residence](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/WRD_Summit_1_86b103f80d.jpg) Dubai| United Arab Emirates ### W Residences](https://darglobal.co.uk/w-residences "W Residences") ## Articles And News [![Image 10](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/DAR_W_Residences_Dubai_Downtown_02_1920x920_05b7df800d.jpg) Feb 20, 2023 ## DarGlobal awards the main works of W Residences in downtown Dubai for AED273,000,000 AED DarGlobal, the luxury real estate developer, is set to begin main works on the highly anticipated W Residences and has awarded the W-Residences project construction to China State Construction Engineering Corporation -Middle East (CSCEC ME).](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/darglobal-awards-the-main-works-of-w-residences-in-downtown-dubai-for-aed273000000-aed "DarGlobal awards the main works of W Residences in downtown Dubai for AED273,000,000 AED")[![Image 11](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/DAR_W_Residences_Dubai_Downtown_01_1920x920_69baed9135.jpg) Feb 25, 2022 ## DarGlobal reveals W Residences Dubai – Downtown overlooking Dubai’s Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the W Residences Dubai – Downtown in the bustling heart of Dubai, offering hotel-inspired living at one of the most sought-after addresses in the world. The 1 billion AED development is anticipated to mark the first standalone residences in the world under the iconic lifestyle W Hotels brand.](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-al-arkan-reveals-w-residences-dubai-downtown-overlooking-dubais-burj-khalifa-and-dubai-fountain "DarGlobal reveals W Residences Dubai – Downtown overlooking Dubai’s Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain") ## Frequently Asked Questions - W Residences ### Who developed W Residences Dubai – Downtown? [W Residences Dubai](https://darglobal.co.uk/w-residences) – Downtown is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with W Hotels, with residence management by Marriott International. ### Where is W Residences Dubai – Downtown located? The residences sit in Downtown Dubai, with views of Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Fountain, Dubai Opera and Old Town Dubai. ### How many residences does the tower include? The tower comprises 384 exclusive residences. ### What is the value of W Residences Dubai – Downtown? The development was valued at AED 1 billion at launch, with main construction works later awarded for AED 273 million. ### When is W Residences Dubai – Downtown expected to complete? Completion was originally estimated for September 2026. Please verify with the sales team for the final building handover and move-in schedule. ### Is this the first standalone W-branded residential project in the world? Yes, [W Residences Dubai](https://darglobal.co.uk/w-residences) – Downtown marks the first standalone residences globally under the W Hotels brand, developed by [DarGlobal](https://darglobal.co.uk/). ### What amenities does W Residences offer? Residents have access to the FUEL wellness concept, an infinity pool overlooking Burj Khalifa, the FIT Fitness Centre, a spa, a media room with cinema, a coworking space and a clubhouse. ### What is the Whatever/Whenever service? Whatever/Whenever is W Hotels' signature concierge service, offering round-the-clock in-residence dining, housekeeping, laundry and lifestyle assistance. ### How far is W Residences from key Dubai landmarks? The residences are about 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 10 minutes from DIFC, and minutes from The Dubai Mall. ### Are units still available at W Residences Dubai – Downtown? The development has previously been reported as sold out; buyers interested in resale opportunities should check current availability with DarGlobal directly. text:
[![Image 6: Darglobal](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/and_Walsh_DAR_Global_Silver_Logo_03_3_1a7c2dce58.webp)](https://darglobal.co.uk/ "DarGlobal") [Register Interest](https://darglobal.co.uk/partners/fendi-casa#) [+1 212 715 1067](tel: +1 212 715 1067 "Call to +1 212 715 1067") [](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=97180040409&text= "Chat with us on WhatsApp") English|العربية ![Image 7: fendi hero image.webp](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/fendi_hero_image_ef4797038c.webp) # Fendi Casa ## Fendi Casa Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences Luxury, Redefined Fendi Casa partnered with DarGlobal on Azure Oceanfront Villas, an AIDA, Oman development that carries a century of Roman design heritage into residential interiors. This landmark collaboration marks Fendi Casa's continued expansion beyond fashion, translating the house's legacy of craftsmanship into a place to live. Two houses. One built on decades of couture, one on decades of skyline. The result? Elegance, tradition, and experimentation, folded into every interior surface. It's more than a villa, it's a house history you can inhabit. It's Rome, brought to the sea. ## related projects [![Image 8: DGxFendi_Mansions Wadi Safar_back_day_440x420.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/D_Gx_Fendi_Mansions_Wadi_Safar_back_day_440x420_06082ec117.png) Wadi Safar | Riyadh | Saudi Arabia ### DarGlobal Mansions Interiors by Fendi Casa](https://darglobal.co.uk/rayana/darglobal-mansions-fendi-casa "DarGlobal Mansions Interiors by Fendi Casa")[![Image 9: fendi casa.webp](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/fendi_casa_a1adad4418.webp) AIDA | Oman ### Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa](https://darglobal.co.uk/one-of-one/fendi-casa-azure-oceanfront-villas "Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa") [![Image 10: DGxFendi_Mansions Wadi Safar_back_day_440x420.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/D_Gx_Fendi_Mansions_Wadi_Safar_back_day_440x420_06082ec117.png) Wadi Safar | Riyadh | Saudi Arabia ### DarGlobal Mansions Interiors by Fendi Casa](https://darglobal.co.uk/rayana/darglobal-mansions-fendi-casa "DarGlobal Mansions Interiors by Fendi Casa") [![Image 11: fendi casa.webp](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/fendi_casa_a1adad4418.webp) AIDA | Oman ### Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa](https://darglobal.co.uk/one-of-one/fendi-casa-azure-oceanfront-villas "Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa") ## Articles And News [![Image 12](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/azureoceanfrontvillas2_jpg_822d7f4e89.webp) Jun 29, 2026 ## Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman Dar Global and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally.](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/darglobal-fendi-casa-announce-azure-oceanfront-villas-oman "Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman") ## Frequently Asked Questions - Fendi Casa ### Who developed Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by Fendi Casa? [Azure Oceanfront Villas](https://darglobal.co.uk/one-of-one/fendi-casa-azure-oceanfront-villas) is developed by [DarGlobal](https://darglobal.co.uk/) in partnership with Fendi Casa, part of the AIDA master development in Oman. ### Where are the Azure Oceanfront Villas located? The villas sit within AIDA, DarGlobal's hilltop master development on the coast near Muscat, Oman. ### What is Fendi Casa? Fendi Casa is the home and interiors division of the Italian luxury house FENDI, founded in Rome in 1925. ### What does the FENDI name bring to these villas? FENDI brings a century of Italian craftsmanship and design innovation to residential interiors for the first time through this collaboration. ### Who has led FENDI's creative direction over the years? Creative direction has passed through the Fendi family, Karl Lagerfeld from 1965 to 2019, Silvia Venturini Fendi, Kim Jones from 2020 to 2024, and Delfina Delettrez Fendi on jewellery since 2020. ### What is AIDA? AIDA is one of Oman's largest premium mixed-use developments, spanning 3.5 million square metres on a hilltop over 100 metres above sea level. ### Are unit types, sizes or pricing confirmed for the Azure Oceanfront Villas? Specific unit details and pricing have not yet been published; contact DarGlobal directly for the latest release information. ### When is AIDA expected to complete its first phase? AIDA's first phase is expected to complete in 2027. ### What other brands are part of AIDA? AIDA also includes Trump International Hotel, Trump Golf Villas, Trump Cliff Villas and Marriott Residences. ### What makes this collaboration distinct? It marks Fendi Casa's entry into branded residential real estate, bringing FENDI's century of Italian luxury heritage to an oceanfront setting within AIDA. Development rights secured for ~US 2.8$ billion project via partial land acquisitions and a joint development agreement. • Announced landmark joint development agreement for a ~US 1.9$ billion GDV project on a prime parcel in Jeddah. Plans include luxury villas, a world-class golf course, and a luxury hotel. • Litmus financing facility enhanced – Additional US$ 165 million secured, increasing the Litmus facility to US$ 440 million. Enhances liquidity and supports international expansion • Proposed entry into asset management through the strategic acquisition of a licensed financial services platform in the DIFC, subject to regulatory approval, to unlock global capital and enable expansion into new geographies • Launched Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai, UAE, a landmark luxury development branded under the Trump name, reinforcing Dar Global’s footprint in the UAE. • Announced Development plan of Trump International Golf Club, Doha and Ultra-Luxury Beachfront Villas Within the Simaisima Community AT A GLANCE continued STRATEGIC REPORT GOVERNANCE REPORT FINANCIAL STATEMENTS DAR GLOBAL PLC ANNUAL REPORT & ACCOUNTS 2025 13 A Year of Unprecedented Growth and Global Expansion 2025 was by any measure a transformative year for Dar Global—one that saw us more than double our project pipeline to approximately USD 19 billion, expand into new markets, and deliver on the financial commitments we made to you when we set out our guidance in 2023. The growth we achieved this year is not just a reflection of market conditions; it is a testament to the extraordinary team we have built and the trust you, our shareholders and partners, continue to place in our vision. Strategic Expansion, Landmark Launches and Focused Execution Our most notable milestone was our broadened entry into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, where we acquired strategic lands for landmark projects in Riyadh and Jeddah. We successfully launched these prestigious projects in January 2026 in partnership with the Trump brand. These developments underscore our confidence in the Kingdom’s robust fundamentals and alignment with Vision 2030. Having witnessed firsthand the energy and ambition of the Kingdom’s transformation under Vision 2030, I am confident that Saudi Arabia will be a cornerstone of our growth. Our presence in Qatar with Trump International Golf Club Doha and Simaisima Villas, alongside continued momentum in the UAE and Oman, reinforce our leadership in the region’s luxury markets. We successfully launched projects this year that exemplify our commitment to design excellence and innovation. These include D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates and the Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, a flagship mixed-use development that further strengthen our leadership in Dubai’s luxury real estate sector. These projects reflect what we do best: partnering with world-renowned brands to create iconic living spaces in high-growth markets. Execution continues to be central to our operations. Main works contractors were appointed for Astera, Trump Tower Jeddah, D-Villas, and our projects within AIDA Phase I and Spain illustrating our dedication to operational excellence and on-time delivery that meets the highest expectations of our stakeholders. Strengthening Financial Capacity and Governance I am proud to report that we achieved our revenue and EBITDA guidance announced in 2023. We delivered strong results for 2025, with revenues of USD 538.6 million, EBITDA of USD 126.6 million, and net profit of USD 100.8 million. The year also marked a major milestone in our capital markets journey as Dar Global received FCA approval for transfer to the LSE’s Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category, becoming the first GCC based company in this category. We celebrated this achievement by ringing the LSE opening bell, as we unveiled our global brand message “Live All In,” symbolizing Dar Global’s ambition to create exceptional lifestyle experiences across our portfolio. Financial flexibility remains a cornerstone of our capital-light strategy. In 2025, we enhanced our Litmus facility by USD 165 million and initiated a proposed acquisition of a licensed DIFC platform to enter asset management, subject to regulatory approval, expanding our access to global capital. Outlook: Confidence in a Dynamic Future While the conflict that erupted in the Gulf in February 2026 has introduced a new dimension of regional uncertainty, Dar Global enters 2026 from a position of financial strength — with strong liquidity, disciplined capital deployment, and the strategic patience to pursue compelling acquisitions as opportunities arise in the market. Our focus on luxury branded residences, and the globally mobile clientele they attract, provides us with long term resilience and positions us to emerge from this period stronger than we entered it. Looking ahead, we remain committed to selective expansion, strategic partnerships, and iconic projects that create enduring value for our shareholders and unparalleled experiences for our customers. Appreciation I want to express my deep appreciation — to our shareholders for your continued trust, to our brand partners for their creativity and collaboration, and to every member of the Dar Global team for their tireless commitment this year. You are the reason this company is what it is. The foundations laid in 2025 — in Saudi Arabia, across our capital structure, and on the London Stock Exchange — position this company for a defining chapter ahead. The best is yet to come for Dar Global. David R. Weinreb Chairman A Year of Unprecedented Growth and Global Expansion David R. Weinreb Chairman “ “ CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT STRATEGIC REPORT GOVERNANCE REPORT FINANCIAL STATEMENTS DAR GLOBAL PLC ANNUAL REPORT & ACCOUNTS 2025 14 Live All In: Turning Global Ambition into Measurable Progress Ziad El Chaar Chief Executive Officer “ “ CEO’S STATEMENT Dear Shareholders, In November 2025, we rang the opening bell in the London Stock Exchange - a defining moment in our journey. As the first Saudi-born company and the first from the wider Middle East to join the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category on the LSE's Main Market, we marked this historic milestone by unveiling our global brand message: Live All In. These three words embody everything we stand for viz. luxury without compromise, investment with discipline, and the conviction to transform global aspirations into tangible realities. This philosophy is not merely aspirational; it is operational. Throughout 2025, we expanded into markets, launched signature developments, accelerated sales momentum, and advanced project execution to deliver exceptional experiences to our customers. Our portfolio of branded luxury developments grew substantially, our public market platform strengthened, and we delivered financial results in line with market guidance. Building Scale Through Strategic Expansion 2025 marked a year of significant growth. Our gross development value expanded from USD 7.5 billion in 2024 to USD 19 billion in 2025, driven primarily by strategic land acquisitions in Riyadh and Jeddah. We launched these landmark Saudi projects in January 2026, marking a decisive entry into one of the world's most dynamic real estate markets. This growth reflects more than numbers—it demonstrates confidence in our business model and the structural transformation underway in Saudi Arabia. As the Kingdom enters a new era of openness and global integration aligned with Vision 2030, we are strategically positioned to connect international investors with unprecedented opportunities in luxury real estate. We strengthened our regional footprint with Trump International Golf Club Doha and Simaisima Villas in Qatar, while in the UAE, we reinforced our market leadership with the launch of Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai—the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded hotel and tower—and D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates, extending our presence in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities. From Launch to Delivery: Execution Excellence Execution remained paramount throughout the year. We successfully completed Da Vinci Tower by Pagani, with customer handovers now underway a testament to our ability to deliver world-class developments on schedule. We also awarded main construction contracts for Astera, Trump Tower Jeddah, Jumeirah Golf Estates villas, Great Escape under AIDA Phase I, and our Spain development, accelerating delivery timelines across our entire portfolio. Delivering Results in Line with Guidance In FY2024, we communicated a clear market objective: achieving cumulative revenue of USD 700 million across 2024 and 2025. I am pleased to confirm that we achieved this cumulative target, reflecting the quality of our portfolio, the strength of demand for our branded luxury proposition, and our execution discipline. In 2025, revenue reached USD 538.6 million (FY2024: USD 240.3 million), driven by the achievement of key construction and revenue recognition milestones across our portfolio. As anticipated, progress across our developments enabled the recognition of a significantly greater proportion of revenue this year. Gross profit stood at USD 189.7 million with a margin of 35% (FY2024: 36%), while EBITDA totalled USD 126.6 million (FY2024: USD 30.1 million), supporting an average EBITDA margin across 2024 and 2025 broadly comparable to FY2023. QATAR DRIVING LONG-TERM INVESTMENT APPEAL Market overview Qatar’s residential market recorded a notable annual increase in the value and volume of residential transactions in Q3 2025, reflecting buyers’ confidence and strong investment appetite across key districts, demonstrating resilience in the face of regional geopolitical tensions. title: DarGlobal FY25 Full Statement of Results
text: 1 Dar Global PLC (Incorporate in England and Wales) Company Number: 14388348 ISIN: GB00BQXNJY41 LEI: 213800XRFXQ1KEWACW80 11 March 2026 DAR GLOBAL PLC (‘Dar Global’, or the ‘Company’, or the ‘Group’) Full-Year Results ‘Record growth with GDV doubling to US$19 billion, landmark project launches, strategic expansion into Saudi Arabia, and strong financial delivery, backed by enhanced capital flexibility’ Dar Global, the luxury international real estate developer, today announces its audited full-year-results for the year ended 31 December 2025 (‘FY25’, the ‘year’ or the ‘period’). Highlights  Portfolio Gross Development Value ('GDV') increased to US$19 billion (31 December 2024: GDV of US$7.5 billion)  Dar Global received approval from the UK Financial Conduct Authority (‘FCA’) for admission to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category of the London Stock Exchange (‘LSE’). The Company became the first GCC-based company listed under the ESCC category.  In August 2025, Dar Global secured development rights for an integrated scheme in Riyadh valued at ~US$2.8 billion through partial land acquisitions and a joint development agreement, anchored by a US$300 million land acquisition.  In September 2025, the Company acquired a prime plot in Jeddah to launch Trump Plaza, the second collaboration in Jeddah with The Trump Organization following the success of Trump Tower.  The Company announced on 11 August 2025 a landmark joint development agreement for a mixed - use project in Jeddah, on one of th e city’s most prominent land parcels, with an estimated GDV of approximately ~US$1.95 billion. These are significant parcels of land with the opportunity to develop luxury villas, a world-class golf course and a luxury hotel.  The Company has awarded the m ain construction contracts for Trump Tower Jeddah; The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin; Marea by Missoni (Blocks C and D); Great Escape Apartments; and Phase 1 of the Aida development in Oman, comprising 91 villas and 60 townhouses.  Dar Global extended its Litmus Facility by an additional US$165 million, bringing the total limit under the Litmus Facility to US$440 million further enhancing liquidity and supporting acquisition / expansion across key international markets.  As announced on 11 August 2025, Dar Global intends to enter the financial services sector in the Dubai International Finance Centre (‘DIFC’), enabling it to offer asset management, investment banking, and advisory services through an independently governed subsidiary. This strategic move will open new revenue streams, attract capital from the GCC and beyond, support larger -scale, capital -efficient projects, and enable entry into new geographies.  On 18 November 2025, Dar Global and The Trump Organization announced Trump International Hotel Maldives, a tokenised hotel development project. Commenting on the full-year results, Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Dar Global, said: "2025 marked a defining year for Dar Global as we more than doubled our portfolio GDV to US$19 billion, delivered on our cumulative revenue guidance, and secured our historic LSE reclassification. With strong sales 2 momentum, accelerating project execution, and a strate gic foothold in Saudi Arabia ahead of its landmark opening to foreign investors, we remain resilient. Despite the prevailing global uncertainties, we enter 2026 with conviction in our strategy and full confidence in our ability to drive sustainable growth and long-term value creation for our stakeholders." FY25 Financial Highlights  Revenue for the period was US$538.6 million (FY24: US$240.3 million) with a gross profit of US$189.7 million (FY24: US$87.4 million).  EBITDA for the period was US$126.6 million (FY24: US$30.1 million).  Profit for the period was US$100.8 million (FY24: US$14.9 million).  Gross Development Value (‘GDV’) of the project portfolio stood at US$19 billion as of 31 December 2025, reflecting an increase from US$7.5 billion as of 31 Decemb er 2024. Primarily, driven by the large -scale development projects in Saudi Arabia.  Robust demand for newly launched and existing projects with cumulative contracted sales rising to 3,824 units as of 31 December 2025, resulting in total sales value of c. US$3.2 billion (31 December 2024: 2,407 units, total sales value of c. US$1.7 billion).  Strong balance sheet and liquidity position with cash balances of US$701.5 million, comprising free cash of c. US$83.4 million and restricted escrow cash of US$618.0 million (including escrow retentions of US$33.5 million).  Net asset value of US$584.4 million on 31 December 2025 (US$478.5 million as at 31 December 2024).  Total available liquidity of c. US$311.7 million at 31 December 2025 (including undrawn debt facilities), providing a platform to pursue opportunistic growth and expand the current portfolio of assets. EBITDA is used by management to evaluate the Group’s underlyin g operating performance, excluding the impact of non-operational items such as financing costs, tax charges, and depreciation and amortisation related adjustments. 3 Summary of Balance Sheet About Dar Global Dar Global PLC is a highly differentiated international real estate business. It focuses predominantly on developing real estate projects comprising second and vacation homes for internationally mobile customers, in some of the most desirable locations across the Middle East and Europe, including downtown Dubai, Muscat in Oman, London and the Costa del Sol region in the South of Spain. Dar Global was originally established to house and develop the international assets of Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development PJSC (‘DAARE’), a leading real estate developer in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Listed on the Saudi Stock Exchange since 2007, Dar Al Arkan has delivered over 15,000 residential units with total assets of c. US$11 billion. The Company intends to expand its focus to hospitality assets. The aim is to acquire or build hotels and sell them after a period of three to five years of operation once the hotels or resorts’ revenue streams stabilise. Target markets include Spain, Dubai, Maldives, Athens, Saudi Arabia and London. Dar Global was admitted to the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange on 28 February 2023. The growth we achieved this year i s not just a reflection of market conditions; it is a testament to the extraordinary team we have built and the trust our shareholders and partners, continue to place in our vision. Strategic Expansion, Landmark Launches and Focused Execution Our most notable milestone was our broadened entry into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, where we acquired strategic lands for landmark projects in Riyadh and Jeddah. We successfully launched these prestigious projects in January 2026 in partnership with the Trump brand. These developments underscore our confidence in the Kingdom’s robust fundamentals and alignment with Vision 2030. Having witnessed firsthand the energy and ambition of the Kingdom's transformation under Vision 2030, I am confident that Saudi Arabia will be a cornerstone of our growth. Our presence in Qatar with Trump International Golf Club Doha and Simaisima Villas, alongside continued momentum in the UAE and Oman, reinforce our leadership in the region's luxury markets. We successfully launched projects this year that exemplify our commitment to design excellence and innovation These include D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates and the Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, a flagship mixed-use development that further strengthen our leadership in Dubai’s luxury real estate sector. These projects reflect what we do best: partnering with world-renowned brands to create iconic living spaces in high- growth markets. Execution continues to be central to our operations. Main works contractors were appointed for Astera, Trump Tower Jeddah, D-Villas, and our projects within AIDA Phase I and Spain illustrating our dedication to operational excellence and on-time delivery that meets the highest expectations of our stakeholders. Strengthening Financial Capacity and Governance I am proud to report that we achieved our revenue and EBITDA guidance announced in 2023. We delivered strong results for FY 2025, with revenues of USD 538.6 million, EBITDA of USD 126.6 million, and net profit of USD 100.8 million. The year also marked a major milestone in our capital markets journey as Dar Global received FCA approval for transfer to the LSE’s Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category, becoming the first GCC based company in this category. We celebrated this achievement by ringing the LSE opening bell, as we unveiled our global brand message ‘Live All In’, symbolising Dar Global’s ambition to create exceptional lifestyle experiences across our portfolio. Financial flexibility remains a cornerstone of our capital-light strategy. In 2025, we enhanced our Litmus facility by US$165 million and initiated a proposed acquisition of a licensed DIFC platform to enter asset management, subject to regulatory approval, expanding our access to global capital. Outlook: Confidence in a Dynamic Future While the conflict that erupted in the Gulf in February 2026 has introduced a new dimension of regional uncertainty, Dar Global enters 2026 from a position of financial strength — with strong liquidity, disciplined capital deployment, and the strategic patience to pursue compelling acquisitions as opportunities arise in the market. Our focus on luxury branded residences, and the globally mobile clientele they attract, provides us with long term resilience and positions us to emerge from this period stronger than we entered it. Looking ahead, we remain committed to selective expansion, strategic partnerships, and iconic projects that create enduring value for our shareholders and unparalleled experiences for our customers. Appreciation I want to express my deep appreciation, to our shareholders for your continued trust, to our brand partners for their creativity and collaboration, and to every member of the Dar Global team for their tireless commitment this year. You are the reason this compan y is what it is. The foundations laid in 2025 in Saudi Arabia, across our capital structure, and on the London Stock Exchange, position this Company for a defining chapter ahead. The best is yet to come for Dar Global. David R. Weinreb Chairman 5 CEO Statement Live All In: Turning Global Ambition into Measurable Progress In November 2025, we rang the opening bell in the London Stock Exchange, a defining moment in our journey. As the first Saudi-born company and the first from the wider Middle East to join the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category on the LSE's Main Market, we marked this historic milestone by unveiling our global brand message: ‘Live All In’. These three words embody everything we stand for viz. luxury without compromise, investment with discipline, and the conviction to transform global aspirations into tangible realities. This philosophy is not merely aspirational; it is operational. Throughout 2025, we expanded into markets, launched signature developments, accelerated sales momentum, and advanced project execution to deliver exceptional experiences to our customers. Our portfolio of branded luxury developments grew substantially, our public market platform strengthened, and we delivered financial results in line with market guidance. Building Scale Through Strategic Expansion 2025 marked a year of significant growth. Our gross development value expanded from US$7.5 billion in 2024 to US$19 billion in 2025, driven primarily by strategic land acquisitions in Riyadh and Jeddah . We launched these landmark Saudi projects in January 2026, marking a decisive entry into one of the world's most dynamic real estate markets. This growth reflects more than numbers, it demonstrates confidence in our business model and the structural transformation underway in Saudi Arabia. As the Kingdom enters a new era of openness and global integration aligned with Vision 2030, we are strategically positioned to connect international investors with unprecedented opportunities in luxury real estate. We strengthened our regional footprint with Trump International Golf Club Doha and Simaisima Villas in Qatar, while in the UAE, we reinforced our market leadership with the launch of Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded hotel and tower, and D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates, extending our presence in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities. From Launch to Delivery: Execution Excellence Execution remained paramount throughout the year. We successfully completed DaVinci Tower by Pagani, with customer handovers now underway a testament to our ability to deliver world-class developments on schedule. We also awarded main construction contracts for Astera, Trump Tower Jeddah, Jumeirah Golf Estates villas, Great Escape under AIDA Phase I, and our Spain development, accelerating delivery timelines across our entire portfolio. Delivering Results in Line with Guidance In FY24, we communicated a clear market objective: achieving cumulative revenue of US$700 million across 2024 and 2025. I am pleased to confirm that we achieved this cumulative target, reflecting the quality of our portfolio, the strength of demand for our branded luxury proposition, and our execution discipline. In FY25, revenue reached US$538.6 mill ion (FY24: US$240.3 million), driven by the achievement of key construction and revenue recognition milestones across our portfolio. As anticipated, progress across our developments enabled the recognition of a significantly greater proportion of revenue t his year. Gross profit stood at US$189.7 million with a margin of 35% (FY24: 36%), while EBITDA totalled US$126.6 million (FY24: US$30.1 million), supporting an average EBITDA margin across FY24 and FY25 broadly comparable to FY23. Net profit for the year reached US$100.8 million (FY24: US$14.9 million). Our financial position remains robust. Cash and cash equivalents stood at US$701.5 million (including project escrow balances and escrow retention) with undrawn debt facilities of US$228.2 million (FY24: US$424.4 million and US$53.1 million respectively), providing the financial flexibility to capitalise on attractive opportunities whilst maintaining our disciplined approach to capital allocation. Saudi Arabia: A Structural Opportunity Aligned with Vision 2030 Saudi Arabia represents a cornerstone of our strategy. The Kingdom's real estate transformation, driven by Vision 2030, is reshaping demand and broadening global participation. With the property market opening to foreign non-resident investment in January 2026, we believe Dar Global is strategically positioned to capitalize on this defining moment. Our Saudi portfolio, now a significant component of our US$19 billion GDV, enables us to capture this structural opportunity while benefiting from the King dom's demographic strength, economic diversification, and infrastructure investment. Innovation: Technology, Financial Services and New Investment Structures 6 Innovation remains a strategic pillar of Dar Global. In 2025, we progressed a proposed acquisition of a DIFC- licensed financial services platform, subject to regulatory approval, to provide asset management capabilities and strengthen our ability to attract international capital into real estate. Alongside this platform expansion, we contin ued to explore and invest in technologies that can improve the customer journey, expand investor access, and enhance operational efficiency:  Artificial Intelligence: We are harnessing AI to transform how luxury real estate connects with discerning investo rs, sharpening campaign precision, elevating lead quality, personalizing content creation, and reimagining property discovery. Our approach ensures technology amplifies human insight rather than replaces it, recognising that exceptional real estate decisions are built on both data intelligence and emotional resonance.  Tokenisation and Digital Ownership Models: Dar Global continues advancing its tokenisation proposition using blockchain-powered structures to evolve how investors access high-value luxury real estate, including fractional participation through regulated platforms. This innovation has the potential to democratise access to premium real estate investment while maintaining appropriate investor protections. Operational Excellence and Global Distribution Our operational capabilities strengthened significantly during the year. Our global distribution network now comprises over 150 sales professionals across nine sales offices, supported by more than 1,300 active brokers in over 60 countries, enabling us to effectively reach sophisticated investors worldwide. Our capital -light business model based on off -plan sales, joint development agreements, and fixed -price construction contracts provides substantial risk mitigation while maintaining strong returns on invested capital as we scale. Dar Global PLC and its subsidiaries London - United Kingdom Notes to the consolidated financial statements (In United States dollar) 29 2 Material accounting policies (continued) 2.3 Fair value measurement (continued) The fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either: - In the principal market for the asset or liability, or - In the absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous market for the asset or liability. The principal or the most advantageous market must be accessible to the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions that market participants would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in their best economic interest. A fair value measurement of a non -financial asset takes into account a market participant’s ability to generate economic benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market participant that would use the asset in its highest and best use. 2.4 Foreign currency The transactions in currencies other than the Group’s presentation currency are recognized at the rates of exchange prevailing at the dates of the transactions. Non-monetary items that are measured in terms of historical cost in a foreign currency are not retranslated. Lease liabilities are measured at the present value of the contractual payments due to the lessor over the lease term, with the discount rate determined by reference to the rate inherent in the lease unless (as is typically the case) this is not readily determinable, in which case the group’s incremental borrowing rate on commencement of the lease is used. Variable lease payments are only included in the measurement of the lease liability if they depend on an index or rate. In such cases, the initial measurement of the lease liability assumes the variable element will remain unchanged throughout the lease term. Other variable lease payments are expensed in the period to which they relate. On initial recognition, the carrying value of the lease liability also includes:  amounts expected to be payable under any residual value guarantee;  the exercise price of any purchase option granted in favor of the group if it is reasonably certain to assess that option;  any penalties payable for terminating the lease, if the term of the lease has been estimated based on termination option being exercised. Right of use assets are initially measured at the amount of the lease liability, reduced for any lease incentives received, and increased for:  lease payments made at or before commencement of the lease;  initial direct costs incurred; and  the amount of any provision recognized where the group is contractually required to dismantle, remove or restore the leased asset. Subsequent to initial measurement lease liabilities increase as a result of interest charged at a constant rate on the balance outstanding and are reduced for lease payments made. Right-of-use assets are amortised on a straight- line basis over the remaining term of the lease or over t he remaining economic life of the asset if, rarely, this is judged to be shorter than the lease term. 2.7 Development properties Properties constructed or in the course of construction for sale in the ordinary course of business are classified as development properties and are stated at the lower of cost or net realizable value.
